spec.description:
Lists the MetricsHub agents feeding this dashboard.

Version, Build Date, Build Number: version and build of the agent.

Connectors Version: version of the connectors library used by the agent.

Last Seen: last time the agent reported metrics. An agent that has not been seen recently means its hosts are no longer being monitored.

spec.expr:
topk by (agent_host_name) (
  1,
  last_over_time(timestamp(metricshub_agent_info)[6h:])
)

spec.title: Dashboard Version
spec.description: Version of this dashboard.

spec.title: Total Transfers Rate
spec.description: Total data transfer rate across all monitored storage systems, split between reads and writes.

spec.expr: sum by (storage_io_direction) (rate(storage_io_bytes_total{storage_type="storage_system", storage_io_direction=~"read|write"}[5m]))

spec.title: Total Operations Rate
spec.description: Total I/O operations per second across all monitored storage systems, split between reads and writes.

spec.expr: sum by (storage_io_direction) (rate(storage_operations_total{storage_type="storage_system", storage_io_direction=~"read|write"}[5m]))

spec.title: Total Raw vs Usable Capacity
spec.description:
Compares the raw size of all storage systems with the capacity they report as usable for data. 

Raw Size is the total size of the storage devices. Usable Capacity is the limit against which usage is measured. 

The difference is space not exposed as usable, which can include RAID protection, spares, system reserve, or capacity not yet configured into pools.

spec.expr: sum(storage_size_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"})
sum(storage_limit_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"})

spec.title: Total Capacity Usage
spec.description:
Current capacity usage across all monitored storage systems. 

Consumed is the space currently storing data. Available is the space the storage systems report as free and ready for new data. Together they make up the total capacity usable for data.

spec.expr: sum(storage_usage_bytes{storage_type="storage_system", storage_provisioning_state="used"})
sum(storage_usage_bytes{storage_type="storage_system", storage_provisioning_state="free"})

spec.title: Top Storage Systems by Transfers
spec.description: Top 5 storage systems by current I/O throughput (read + write combined, 5-minute rate).

spec.description:
Storage fleet summary per vendor.

Storage Systems: number of monitored storage systems from this vendor.

Size: total raw size of the storage devices.

Capacity: total capacity usable for data.

Available Capacity: space reported as free and ready for new data.

Consumed Capacity: space currently storing data.

Consumed Capacity %: share of the space usable for data that is currently consumed.

spec.expr: count by (vendor) (storage_size_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"})
sum by (vendor) (storage_size_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"})
sum by (vendor) (storage_limit_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"})
sum by (vendor) (storage_usage_bytes{storage_type="storage_system", storage_provisioning_state="free"})

spec.description: Live list of the alerts currently firing on the storage systems and their hardware.

spec.title: Critical
spec.description: Number of critical issues currently affecting the storage systems: firing critical alerts plus failed hardware components.

spec.expr:
(
  count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", severity="critical", alertname=~"MetricsHub-Storage-.*"})
  or vector(0)
)
+ on()
(
  sum(hw_status{state="failed", host_name=~"$host_name"} == 1)
  or vector(0)
)

spec.title: Warning
spec.description: Number of warning-level issues currently affecting the storage systems: firing warning alerts plus hardware components that are degraded or predicted to fail.

spec.title: Failed Protocols
spec.description: Number of monitoring protocols currently failing to respond across all storage systems. A failed protocol means part or all of a system can no longer be monitored.

spec.expr: count(metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"} == 0)

spec.title: Unhealthy Systems
spec.description:
Storage systems currently reporting problems. Healthy systems are not listed.

Critical Alerts: number of critical alerts currently firing on the system, plus its failed hardware components.

Warnings: number of warning alerts currently firing, plus hardware components that are degraded or predicted to fail.

Failed Protocols: number of monitoring protocols no longer responding on the system.

Failed Connectors: number of storage connectors in error on the system.

Click a system to open its detailed dashboard.

spec.expr:
(count by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"} == 0)) 
or 
(count by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"}) * 0)

(
  count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical", alertname=~"MetricsHub-Storage-.*"}) by (host_name)
  or
  (0 * count by (host_name) (storage_limit_bytes))
)
+
on(host_name)
(
  sum by (host_name) (hw_status{state="failed", host_name=~"$host_name"} == 1)
  or
  (0 * count by (host_name) (storage_limit_bytes))
)

(
  count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", severity="warning", alertname=~"MetricsHub-Storage-.*"}) by (host_name)
  or
  (0 * count by (host_name) (storage_limit_bytes))
)
+
on(host_name)
(
  sum by (host_name) (
    max by (host_name, hw_type, id) (
      hw_status{state=~"degraded|predicted_failure", host_name=~"$host_name"} == 1
    )
  )
  or
  (0 * count by (host_name) (storage_limit_bytes))
)
max by (host_name, vendor, family, model) (storage_limit_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"})

(count by (host_name) (metricshub_connector_status{host_name=~"$host_name", state="failed"} == 1))
or
(count by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"}) * 0)

spec.title: Storage Systems
spec.description: Total number of monitored storage systems.

spec.expr: count(count by (host_name) (storage_size_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"}))

spec.title: Unhealthy Systems
spec.description: Number of storage systems with at least one warning, one critical alert, one protocol down, one connector in error, or one hardware component that is failed, degraded, or predicted to fail.

spec.expr:
count(
  group by (host_name) (
    (metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"} == 0) or
    (metricshub_connector_status{host_name=~"$host_name", state="failed"} == 1) or
    (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", severity="critical", alertname=~"MetricsHub-Storage-.*"}) or
    (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", severity="warning", alertname=~"MetricsHub-Storage-.*"}) or
    (hw_status{state=~"failed|degraded|predicted_failure", host_name=~"$host_name"} == 1)
  )
)

spec.description:
Lists the storage pools whose subscribed capacity exceeds their usable capacity.

Capacity: total usable capacity of the pool available for data.

Subscribed: capacity committed to hosts through volumes mapped to initiators.

Subscription %: ratio of Subscribed to Capacity. Above 100% means the pool is oversubscribed, more capacity has been promised than physically exists.

Consumed Capacity %: share of the pool's usable capacity currently storing data.

Consumed Capacity % Change: change in Consumed Capacity % over the selected time range. Positive values indicate growth.

Growth Rate: rate at which consumed capacity is increasing, averaged over the selected time range.

Time Until Saturation: projected time until the pool's free capacity is fully consumed, assuming consumption keeps growing at the current rate. Pools that are flat or shrinking have no value.

spec.expr:
label_join(
  storage_limit_bytes{host_name=~"$host_name",storage_type="pool"},
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  storage_usage_bytes{host_name=~"$host_name", storage_type="pool", storage_provisioning_state="used"},
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  storage_provisioning_bytes{host_name=~"$host_name", storage_type="pool", storage_provisioning_state="subscribed"},
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  deriv(storage_usage_bytes{host_name=~"$host_name", storage_type="pool", storage_provisioning_state="used"}[$__range]),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

spec.title: Hardware Components
spec.description:
Inventory of hardware components across all storage systems, grouped by component type.

Total: number of components of this type in the fleet.

Failed: components currently reporting a failed state.

Degraded: components that are degraded or predicted to fail.

Healthy %: share of the components of this type with no reported problem.

spec.expr: count by (hw_type) (max by (hw_type, host_name, id) (hw_status{host_name=~"$host_name"}))

count by (hw_type) (hw_status{host_name=~"$host_name", state="failed"} == 1)
or
count by (hw_type) (max by (hw_type, host_name, id) (hw_status{host_name=~"$host_name"})) * 0 # to ensure a zero value

count by (hw_type) (
  max by (hw_type, host_name, id) (
    hw_status{host_name=~"$host_name", state=~"degraded|predicted_failure"} == 1
  )
)
or
count by (hw_type) (max by (hw_type, host_name, id) (hw_status{host_name=~"$host_name"})) * 0 # to ensure a zero value

(
  count by (hw_type) (max by (hw_type, host_name, id) (hw_status{host_name=~"$host_name"}))
  -
  (
    count by (hw_type) (max by (hw_type, host_name, id) (hw_status{host_name=~"$host_name", state=~"failed|degraded|predicted_failure"} == 1))
    or
    count by (hw_type) (max by (hw_type, host_name, id) (hw_status{host_name=~"$host_name"})) * 0
  )
)
/
count by (hw_type) (max by (hw_type, host_name, id) (hw_status{host_name=~"$host_name"}))

spec.description:

sum by (host_name) (rate(storage_operations_total{storage_type="storage_system"}[5m]))
sum by(host_name) (rate(storage_io_bytes_total{storage_type="storage_system"}[5m]))

spec.title: Monitoring Coverage
spec.description:
The percentage of monitored storage systems.

A monitored host is a host with at least one responding connector.

spec.expr: count(max by (host_name) (metricshub_connector_status{host_name=~"$host_name", state="ok"} == 1)) / count(max by (host_name) (present_over_time(metricshub_host_configured{host_name=~"$host_name"}[1h])))

spec.description:
Health and capacity summary of each monitored storage system.

Status: ✅ healthy, ⚠️ at least one warning, ❌ at least one critical issue (unresponsive protocol, connector error, critical alert or failed hardware).

Capacity: total capacity usable for data.

Available: space reported as free and ready for new data.

Consumed: space currently storing data.

Consumed %: share of the usable space currently storing data.

Time Until Saturation: projected time until the system's free space is fully consumed, assuming consumption keeps growing at the current rate.

Thin Prov. Commitment %: capacity promised to hosts relative to the usable capacity. Above 100%, more space has been committed than physically exists.

Click a system to open its detailed dashboard.

spec.expr: storage_limit_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"}

sum by (host_name) (storage_usage_bytes{storage_type="storage_system", storage_provisioning_state="used"})
/
sum by (host_name) (storage_usage_bytes{storage_type="storage_system", storage_provisioning_state=~"used|free"})

sum(storage_provisioning_bytes{storage_type="storage_system", storage_provisioning_state="subscribed"}) by (host_name)
/
sum(storage_limit_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"}) by (host_name)

clamp_max(

  # ===== FAILED (→ 2): protocol error OR connector error OR critical alert OR failed hardware =====
  2 *
  (
    (
      # protocol errors (host unreachable)
      (
          count by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"} == 0)
        or
          (0 * count by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"}))
      )
      + on(host_name)
      # critical alerts
      (
          count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical", alertname=~"MetricsHub-Storage-.*"}) by (host_name)
        or
          (0 * count by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"}))
      )
      + on(host_name)
      # failed hardware
      (
          sum by (host_name) (hw_status{state="failed", host_name=~"$host_name"})
        or
          (0 * count by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"}))
      )
      + on(host_name)
      # connector errors (0 = failed → contributes 1)
      (
          (1 - min by (host_name) (metricshub_connector_status{host_name=~"$host_name", applies_to_os="storage"}))
        or
          (0 * count by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"}))
      )
    ) > bool 0
  )

  + on(host_name)

  # ===== WARNING (→ 1): warning alert OR degraded / predicted-failure hardware =====
  1 *
  (
    (
      # warning alerts
      (
          count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="warning", alertname=~"MetricsHub-Storage-.*"}) by (host_name)
        or
          (0 * count by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"}))
      )
      + on(host_name)
      # degraded / predicted-failure hardware
      (
          sum by (host_name) (hw_status{state=~"degraded|predicted_failure", host_name=~"$host_name"})
        or
          (0 * count by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{host_name=~"$host_name"}))
      )
    ) > bool 0
  )

, 2)
storage_limit_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"}
sum by(host_name) (storage_usage_bytes{storage_type="storage_system", storage_provisioning_state="free"})
sum by (host_name) (storage_usage_bytes{storage_type="storage_system", storage_provisioning_state="used"})

spec.title: Top Storage Consumers by Transfer
spec.description: Top storage consumers by combined read + write I/O throughput on mapped volumes, averaged over the selected time range.

spec.title: Storage Consumers
spec.description:
Number of distinct hosts (or host groups) to which at least one volume is mapped.

Counts unique values of the consumer name across all mapped volumes of all monitored storage systems.

spec.title: Volumes
spec.description: Total number of volumes discovered across all monitored storage systems.

spec.expr: count(storage_limit_bytes{storage_type="volume", netapp_storage_type!="lun"})

spec.title: Total Consumed Capacity
spec.description: Sum of the capacity currently storing data across all volumes of all monitored storage systems.

spec.expr: sum(storage_usage_bytes{storage_type="volume", netapp_storage_type!="lun", storage_provisioning_state="used"})

spec.description:
Breaks the volumes into four categories based on whether each volume is mapped to a host and whether it has served any I/O over the displayed time range.

Mapped & Active - Count: number of volumes mapped to a host that have served I/O over the selected range.

Mapped & Active - Consumed Capacity: capacity currently storing data across the active volumes.

Mapped & Inactive - Count: number of volumes mapped to a host but idle over the selected range.

Mapped & Inactive - Consumed Capacity: space that is exposed to a host but not being used. This is often a sign of stale or forgotten volumes still holding data.

Unmapped - Count: number of volumes that exist but are not mapped to any host.

Unmapped - Consumed Capacity: space consumed on the arrays that no host can reach. Possibly a strong candidate for reclamation.

Not Enough Data: volumes whose read/write activity cannot be evaluated over the selected time range. This can happen when the system does not report volume activity, or when the selected range contains too few usable samples.

spec.title: Total Reclaimable Consumed Capacity
spec.description:
Breaks down the total consumed volume capacity into categories that indicate how much space could potentially be recovered.

Reclaimable Capacity (Inactive or Unmapped): consumed capacity of volumes that are either unmapped, or mapped but idle over the selected time range.

Failed Volume Capacity: consumed capacity of volumes that are mapped to a host but report a failed state.

Active Capacity: consumed capacity of volumes that are mapped to a host and actively serving I/O. 

Activity data is required to classify mapped, non-failed volumes as Active or Inactive. 
Unmapped volumes are always counted as reclaimable, and mapped volumes in a failed state are always counted under Failed Volume Capacity, whether or not activity data is available.
Mapped, non-failed volumes without activity data are not shown in this breakdown; they appear under Not Enough Data in the volume table.

spec.title: Volumes
spec.description: Total number of NetApp volumes discovered across all monitored NetApp systems.

spec.expr: count(storage_limit_bytes{netapp_storage_type="volume"})

spec.title: Total Consumed Capacity
spec.description: Sum of the capacity currently storing data across all NetApp volumes of all monitored NetApp systems.

spec.expr: sum(storage_usage_bytes{netapp_storage_type="volume", storage_provisioning_state="used"})

spec.description:
Active Count: number of volumes that served I/O over the selected time range.

Active Consumed Capacity: total capacity currently stored across active volumes.

Inactive Count: number of volumes that served no measurable I/O over the selected time range.

Inactive Consumed Capacity: total capacity currently stored across inactive volumes.

spec.title: LUNs
spec.description: Total number of NetApp LUNs discovered across all monitored NetApp systems.

spec.expr: count(storage_limit_bytes{netapp_storage_type="lun"})

spec.title: Total Consumed Capacity
spec.description: Sum of the capacity currently storing data across all NetApp LUNs of all monitored NetApp systems.

spec.expr: sum(storage_usage_bytes{netapp_storage_type="lun", storage_provisioning_state="used"})

spec.description:
Breaks the NetApp LUNs into three categories based on whether each LUN is mapped to a host and whether it has served any I/O over the selected time range.

Mapped & Active - Count: number of LUNs mapped to a host that have served I/O over the selected range.

Mapped & Active - Consumed Capacity: capacity currently storing data across the active LUNs.

Mapped & Inactive - Count: number of LUNs mapped to a host but idle over the range.

Mapped & Inactive - Consumed Capacity: space that is exposed to a host but not being used. This often a sign of stale or forgotten volumes still holding data.

Unmapped - Count: number of LUNs that exist but are not mapped to any host.
Unmapped - Consumed Capacity: space consumed on the arrays that no host can reach. Possibly a strong candidate for reclamation.

spec.title: Total Reclaimable Consumed Capacity
spec.description:
Breaks down the total consumed LUN capacity into categories that indicate how much space could potentially be recovered.

Reclaimable Capacity (Inactive or Unmapped): consumed capacity of LUNs that are either unmapped, or mapped but idle over the selected time range.

Failed LUN Capacity: consumed capacity of LUNs that are mapped to a host but report a failed state.

Active Capacity: consumed capacity of LUNs that are mapped to a host and actively serving I/O.

spec.title: Reclaimable Consumed Capacity by System
spec.description:
Consumed capacity that could potentially be recovered on each storage system. 

It counts the space used by volumes and LUNs that are either not mapped to any host, or mapped but idle over the selected time range.

Only systems whose connector reports volume-level information appear in the chart. For systems that do not report volume activity, only the unmapped capacity can be evaluated. NetApp systems are measured through their LUNs.

spec.title: Top Storage Systems by Transfer Increase
spec.description:
Top storage systems by % increase in I/O throughput (bytes/sec) vs. the prior period of equal length.

Only increases are shown, drops don't appear.

spec.expr:
topk(5,
  (
    (
      (
        sum by (host_name) (rate(storage_io_bytes_total{storage_type="storage_system"}[$__range]))
        or
        (sum by (host_name) (storage_limit_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"}) * 0)
      )
      -
      sum by (host_name) (rate(storage_io_bytes_total{storage_type="storage_system"}[$__range] offset $__range))
    )
    /
    (
      sum by (host_name) (rate(storage_io_bytes_total{storage_type="storage_system"}[$__range] offset $__range))
      > 1000
    )
  ) > 0
)

spec.title: Overall Read/Write Transfer %
spec.description:
Read's share of total transfer volume (read + write bytes/sec), aggregated across all storage systems.

Write % is the remainder.

spec.expr:
sum(rate(storage_io_bytes_total{storage_type="storage_system", storage_io_direction="read"}[5m]))
/
sum(rate(storage_io_bytes_total{storage_type="storage_system", storage_io_direction=~"read|write"}[5m]))

spec.title: Capacity Growth (Last 30 Days)
spec.description:
Total consumed capacity across all storage systems, plotted against total usable capacity (dashed line). 

The gap between the two lines is the remaining fleet-wide headroom.

spec.expr: sum(storage_usage_bytes{storage_type="storage_system", storage_provisioning_state="used"})
sum(storage_limit_bytes{storage_type="storage_system"})

spec.title: 90 day Proj. Consumed Capacity
spec.description:
Estimated total consumed capacity across all storage systems 90 days from now.

The projection is based on a linear extrapolation of the growth observed over the last 30 days. If the projected value approaches or exceeds the total usable capacity, additional storage should be provisioned.

spec.expr: clamp_min(predict_linear(sum(storage_usage_bytes{storage_type="storage_system", storage_provisioning_state="used"})[30d:1h], 90*86400), 0)

spec.title: Reclaimable Capacity
spec.description:
Total consumed capacity across the fleet that could potentially be recovered. 

It adds up the space used by volumes and LUNs that are either unmapped, or mapped to a host but idle over the selected time range. 
The breakdown per storage system is shown in the Reclaimable Consumed Capacity by System chart below.

For systems that do not report volume activity, only unmapped capacity is counted. NetApp systems are measured through their LUNs.
